messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — my flight's been rebooked and I need to hand off the 02:00–06:00 UTC slice of my primary shift tonight. I can cover until 02:00 as planned but won't be online after that. Can someone take primary 02:00–06:00 UTC (or split) so there's no coverage gap? @here :airplane:

oncall-bot: Rotation snapshot for 2026-03-14 00:00 UTC window:
• Primary: Maya (until 02:00 UTC)
• Backup: Liam (until 10:00 UTC)
• Next on deck: Jess
Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/oncall-basic-handbook
Use /rotation in Slack or rotation-scheduler API to make temporary swaps.

Liam: I can pick up 02:00–04:00 UTC if that helps. After 04:00 I have a calendar block for on-call review. Not ideal for full 02–06 though.

Jess: I can do 04:00–08:00 UTC — so if Liam covers 02–04 and I take 04–06 (and stay till 08 for overlap) that should close it. I can be primary from 04–06, then switch to backup if needed.

Alex: Sounds fine. If we're doing manual swaps we should update PagerDuty/scheduler. Quick command (rotation-scheduler) that I usually run locally:

```
# assign temp primary
rotation-scheduler assign --user Liam --role primary --start 2026-03-14T02:00Z --end 2026-03-14T04:00Z
rotation-scheduler assign --user Jess --role primary --start 2026-03-14T04:00Z --end 2026-03-14T06:00Z
```

Or use the Slack shortcut: Open /rotation -> 'temporary swap' -> fill times. I'll run the commands if someone gives :thumbsup:.

Maya: Thanks — appreciate it. No active P1s right now but fyi we saw a brief spike of 503s around 23:20 UTC earlier — nothing ongoing. Dashboard: https://observability.redwood/d/resp-503s. If you see more than 2% error rate please escalate per the web-tier runbook.

Noah: Passing on the tip: when you take the first 30m of a swap, run the quick smoke in the runbook to confirm downstream workers are healthy — snippet below. Saved us last week.

Runbook snippet:

```
# quick health checks
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-worker -o wide
curl -s 'https://metrics.redwood/api/queues?name=regen' | jq '.backlog'
curl -s 'https://api.redwood/health' | jq '.services[] | {name,status}'
```

Jess: :thumbsup: I'll take 04–06 and will run the smoke check at 04:05. Liam — if you can post a short handoff note at 04:00 with any anomalies that would be great.

Liam: Will do. I gave Alex the go-ahead to run the rotation-scheduler commands — Alex, you good to execute?

Alex: Running them now. One sec...
rotation-scheduler: Temporary assignment created: Liam -> primary 2026-03-14T02:00Z–2026-03-14T04:00Z :white_check_mark:
rotation-scheduler: Temporary assignment created: Jess -> primary 2026-03-14T04:00Z–2026-03-14T06:00Z :white_check_mark:

Alex: Also updated PagerDuty schedule entries and added a note on the on-call calendar. I've left a small comment on the runbook link with the time ranges.

Maya: Incredible — thank you all. Leaving a short handover note: no running deploys, saw 503 spike earlier but stable now, throttling rules unchanged, secrets rotation not scheduled until next week.

Liam: 02:00 handoff logged. I'll run the quick checks at 02:05 and will ping if anything looks off. :mag:

Jess: I'll be on standby and will follow up at 04:00 for the handover. If Maya needs anything urgent before takeoff DM me.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Please acknowledge any manual swaps by reacting with :white_check_mark: and ensure PagerDuty shows the temporary assignments within 5 minutes.
rotation-scheduler: Swap confirmations recorded in the rota audit log.
Maya: :white_check_mark: — thanks everyone, safe flights to me and good shift to you all.

Alex: :thumbsup: closing thread. If anything breaks ping #incidents and escalate per the P1 runbook.
